claims.claim: Python 3.12 compares aware datetime values with different fixed UTC offsets by the represented instants, so `2026-09-30T17:00:01-07:00` and `2026-10-01T00:00:01Z` compare equal when parsed as aware datetimes.
Python 3.12 compares aware datetimes with different fixed UTC offsets by their represented instants, including equality of 2026-09-30T17:00:01-07:00 and 2026-10-01T00:00:01Z.
